problem_statement: Binding a UDP socket to a multicast IPv6 address (for example ff02::21) is rejected: the bind call returns an invalid-arguments error instead of succeeding, so a receiver that wants to listen on a multicast group cannot bind to it, and multicast-loop delivery to that socket does not occur. Binding to a multicast address should succeed, a message sent to the same multicast group on the same port should be delivered to the bound socket, a message to a different multicast group should not be, and a socket bound to a multicast address that is not subscribed to that group should receive nothing.
oracle_note: observed by validate_instance.py (fail before, pass after the fix); the unit oracle is per executable, so check attribution of the cases to the PR's change
